'''Francesco Maria De Regi''' ([[Milan]], 1720 – 1794) was an Italian [[mathematician]].

He was a [[Barnabites|Barnabite priest]]. He worked particularly on [[hydraulic engineering]]. At twenty-four he took the chair of [[mathematics]], specially created for him, in the school of the Collegio of Sant'Alessandro in Milan.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.consorzioirrigazioni.it/ci/documenti/pdf/FrancescoMariadeRegi.pdf|title=Francesco Maria De Regi|publisher=Consorzio Irrigazioni Cremonesi|language=it|access-date=2016-06-01|archive-date=2017-02-06|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170206212610/http://www.consorzioirrigazioni.it/ci/documenti/pdf/FrancescoMariadeRegi.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref>
